records.statement: Integer bound O(n log n (4√2)^{log* n}); polynomial expansion constant 4 through cyclotomic coefficient rings.
records.model_assumptions: Deterministic bit model; coefficient ring may be a product of fields; principal roots and conversions are constructed.
records.caller_mapping: Amortizing zero-padding across two recursion levels can change a real expansion factor. Preserve principal-root orthogonality in rings with zero divisors and charge CRT conversion.

records.title: Integer multiplication below n log n
locations_read: 00-introduction.tex: two tape operations and exact product; 05-layers.tex: phase identities and explicit guard bound; 06-transforms.tex: signed-ring-product proof; 07-resampling.tex: one-dimensional interface
records.statement: The pinned manuscript states T(n)=O(n (lg n)^{1−2^(−182)}) for one fixed finite-tape exact multiplier.
records.model_assumptions: Research manuscript, not independently re-proved here; complete finite networks, source/sink frames, dyadic precision, CRT layouts and final rounding are obligations.
records.caller_mapping: Current benchmark context. It already uses packed selected bits and signed Kronecker recovery; our new test cannot count them as newly introduced mechanisms. Modular base change applies to finite dyadic identities, not automatically to analytic resampling.
